name: Ikeuchi Emiko
source:
A housewife the protagonist met while engaging in door to door sales. She loves her diligent husband, but since he's busy with his job, her heart and body are both unfulfilled. 

Has large breasts and a nice, ripe and mature body. Has long and wavy hair. She wears a wedding ring in her left ring finger. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/emiko/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
